purpose: Declared continuity-failure audit under the frozen M4-07 negative result. This plan fixes development seeds, actor family, per-cue exposure windows, audit diagnostics, and a finite compute budget BEFORE any M4-08 audit lifetime is executed. It introduces no learning-rule, tick-order, reset-policy, or criterion change: the M4-07 manifest, exposure windows, and acceptance criterion are referenced by hash and left immutable.

frozen_source.m4_07_verdict: 0/3 outer seeds passing; fully persistent late macro accuracy 0.00/0.00/0.94 vs matched B3 0.00/0.00/0.875
frozen_source.note: M4-07 stays unchecked. No seed, window, or criterion in the frozen manifest may be revised to retroactively turn that run into a pass.

actor_family.source: M3-08 frozen full-recurrent winner at M3 grid index 11 (identical to M4-07)

acquisition_windows.note: Same windows as M4-07, reused only to locate the failure (outer 2 learns episodically, not persistently). They are descriptive here, never a new acceptance criterion.

audit_runs.role: focus: the one condition that acquired (late 0.97) on the identical W0/schedule; reference for baseline drift, update alignment, and per-cue behavior
focus: trace clearing alone did not rescue (late 0.00); isolates persistent ACTIVITY as the remaining difference from episodic
focus: fully persistent failure (late 0.00) to audit for interference, drift, timescale, and saturation
matched control rerun in the current revision so every audit leg has a freshly paired nonplastic reference
contrast: the only seed with above-chance persistent accuracy (late 0.94, margin 0.065); what differs from outer 2?
control: documented representation-locked initialization (0.00 under every condition); guards against mistaking a generic lock for a continuity effect
timescale leg: shorter trace keeps less stale credit; paired W0/schedule with the tau_e=32 focus run
timescale leg: longer trace keeps more stale credit; paired W0/schedule with the tau_e=32 focus run

new_development_ranges.reason: Spec 7.9: a trace increment from D ticks ago is retained by exp(-D/tau_e); increasing tau_e preserves older credit but also includes more unrelated activity and previous choices. M4-05 showed trace/update scale grows with tau_e while reward was nonmonotonic. The audit asks descriptively whether outer 2's persistent failure moves with timescale; eta is held fixed so this is not tuning, and no value is adopted without rerunning the matched B3 control (outer2_continuous_b3, tau_e-invariant by construction since B3 holds no E/P/baseline).

diagnostics: per_outcome_series: cue, action, reward, latent correctness, delta, baseline_old/new, eligibility L1 before update, raw/actual update L1, commit/feedback ticks
baseline_drift: baseline trajectory start/mid/end and range, episodic vs persistent on the paired schedule
update_alignment: consecutive-outcome cosine of actual-update matrices (shared-trace interference signature), early vs late
trace_scale: eligibility L1 before update per outcome, persistent vs episodic at matched schedule positions; raw-identity check raw_L1 = eta*|delta|*E_L1 on every persistent outcome
inter_feedback_decay: realized ticks between consecutive feedbacks and implied retained fraction exp(-gap/tau_e)
per_cue_behavior: early/late accuracy and action rates per cue (behavioral representation-lock signature)
health: actor saturation fraction, motor-filter maxima, motor margins from the same lifetimes
representation_probe: synthetic two-cue drive through the outer-2 family learner, fresh vs carryover separation (Section 21.2 diagnostic, never a task readout)

persistent_closed_loop_probe: constant-input synthetic-reward loop with no resets (Section 21.1 smallest system); asks whether the fixed-gate rule still drifts toward the preferred action under full persistence
archive_cross_check: re-run late macro accuracies must reproduce the archived M4-07 records exactly (same code revision, deterministic)
integrity_rules: All 8 lifetimes complete with zero simulation failures; every state finite.
Within each outer seed, all conditions share identical W0 and exogenous event/cue/commit/feedback/noise schedules.
Resets audit: [0] only for continuous runs; episodic/event-reset runs log their declared resets.
No hidden resets, weight decay, membrane clipping, trained decoder, or gate change: fixed gate 1 throughout.
The audit records measurements; it sets no acquisition pass/fail criterion and cannot check M4-07 or M4-GATE.
prohibitions: Do not edit manifests/m4_continuous_acquisition.json, its windows, seeds, or criterion.
Do not inspect validation or final-test seed namespaces.
Do not add a stabilizer (decay, clipping, normalization, homeostasis) to rescue learning.

budget.execution: serial release-mode bounded diagnostic; fresh output directory required
